messages:
maria: pushed a new NextKit starter that wires LangChain + LlamaIndex and includes an eval harness. runs fine locally but CI on the edge runtime hits an auth/retry loop when streaming responses. anyone seen this?

kevin: saw something similar last week with streaming + edge. error logs?

maria: paste log snippet: 
```
ERROR auth: failed to refresh token: 401 unauthorized
at retryHandler (/app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/retry.js:45:12)
stream closed while reconnecting
```

maria: config in starter: 
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, mode: 'edge', streaming: true })
```

alex: is the starter using the browser SDK in server-edge functions? that can drop refresh flow.

maria: yes it's in /app/routes/api/stream.ts, running in Vercel Edge. Tried swapping to the server SDK and the token refresh works but streaming breaks (no chunk events).

sophie: hmm SDK parity issue: server SDK supports refresh + streaming, but browser/edge SDK missing the same SSE fallback. we need consistent behavior across runtimes. filing an issue?

kevin: filing now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/894 (WIP). repro steps and minimal app attached.

ci-bot: Pipeline #482 failed: e2e-nextkit-edge (see logs)

maria: repro steps in the thread: clone starter, set RW_API_KEY to a token with refresh scope, deploy to Vercel Edge or run with vercel dev --edge. call /api/stream and observe repeated 401 + reconnect attempts, then eventual 429 from retry flood.

alex: quick hypothesis: edge runtime's fetch doesn't allow long-lived server-sent events with the current polyfill; client retries on auth failure but the stream is already closed so the retry controller triggers another refresh concurrently, causing invalidation. needs idempotent refresh in SDK.

sophie: suggested fix: make the token refresh a single-flight promise in the SDK so concurrent refresh requests await the same promise. plus, ensure streaming client listens for a 401 chunk and aborts gracefully instead of reconnecting blindly.

kevin: prototype patch attached in the issue: 
- add singleFlightTokenRefresh() util
- update edge fetch wrapper to pass signal from the original request into retry loop
- add tests: simulate SSE 401 then 200 on refresh

maria: i tried the patch locally, it reduces duplicate refresh calls but streaming still loses first few chunks. might be because the runtime returns a closed ReadableStream that can't be resumed. maybe fallback to buffered streaming until token refresh completes.

alex: alternative: buffer first N KB server-side in the starter when running on Edge, so client can recover from a short auth hiccup without state loss. could be a config flag in the starter: { streamingBufferKB: 64 }.

sophie: for SDK parity, we should: 
1) expose a streaming-friendly refresh API (single-flight + abort-aware)
2) document runtime constraints in the starter README (edge vs node)
3) add a test app in examples/ that shows streaming + refresh on both runtimes (netlify/vercel/hosted)

maria: i'll update the starter README and add an opt-in buffer config. also adding an eval harness test that exercises streaming continuity with simulated auth expiry.

kevin: CI action: add e2e job that runs the starter under node and edge emulation (vercel dev) to catch regressions. opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/123 (draft).

devex-bot: Added label "sdk/streaming" and assigned to @sophie and @kevin :gear:

maria: thanks. small follow-up Q: should the starter default to the server SDK when detected in SSR/edge so people don't accidentally ship an incompatible combo?

sophie: i think defaulting to server SDK in SSR server routes is fine; for true edge functions we keep browser/edge SDK but show a warning banner in README and console if streaming + refresh scopes detected.

alex: note for onboarding: add a quick checkbox in the starter setup flow "Edge runtime (experimental)" that toggles buffer and warns about token scopes. reduces surprise.

maria: fine, i'll land README + flag in starter then iterate on the SDK fix. leaving the issue with the prototype patch and tests.

kevin: thanks all. we'll aim to get the single-flight refresh and a streaming test in next sprint. :thumbsup:

sophie: tagging product for visibility on DX breakage: @product (cc: @infra).

maria: putting a short note in the starter CHANGELOG and a migration snippet for users who hit this.
